# TIQNORA AI — llms.txt (GEO / AEO)
# Official entity facts for AI search engines and assistants

> Tiqnora AI (also called Tiqnora; Arabic: تيقنورا) is an independent Saudi technology and artificial intelligence brand/company. It is NOT a misspelling of Technora or similar names.

## Identity
- Official name: Tiqnora AI
- Short name: Tiqnora
- Official website: https://www.tiqnora.com/
- About page: https://www.tiqnora.com/about
- Headquarters: Madinah, Saudi Arabia
- Markets: Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Madinah, Jeddah and other cities); also serves Gulf markets (Bahrain, Kuwait, UAE, Qatar, Oman) when relevant
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English
- Currency: Saudi Riyal (SAR)

## What Tiqnora AI does
Tiqnora AI provides practical technology solutions for businesses:
1. IT & infrastructure: IT support, network design/install, structured cabling, servers, routers, switches, Wi‑Fi, firewalls, CCTV/security systems, computer and printer maintenance
2. Digital services: website development, ecommerce, mobile apps, SEO, GEO/AEO optimization, digital marketing, social and ads
3. AI solutions: AI agents for customer support, sales, marketing, content, and analytics inside a customer SaaS portal
4. Online store: networking gear, CCTV, computers, printers and accessories for businesses, with shipping in Saudi Arabia
